scope: Existing local cell annotation maps and six built-in workbook metadata text fields; no new remote service, sound-note feature, drawing graph, custom-property store or codec. External Follow requires a navigation continuation and fails explicitly. This is a selected native profile, not the whole Excel annotation family.

required_obligations.profile: Classic notes only in Comments; Range.Comment is Nothing when absent or threaded. Bound text editing uses UTF-16 positions and rejects split surrogate edits; NoteText accepts at most 255 UTF-16 units per call. Visibility setters are idempotent. Same-sheet navigation returns Nothing at boundaries. Collections enumerate in native cell order. Protected sheets refuse annotation mutation because the native model has no independent annotation permission.

Native local roots and ordered replies; AddReply uses native local author preference. Replies collection has CommentsThreaded nominal type; navigation remains within roots or replies. Native command service cannot edit/delete individual replies: those operations return 1004. Author.Name reads the native local display label; remote ProviderID/UserID and Date services are unavailable, with no fabricated remote identity or timestamp. Root deletion deletes native thread.

One-cell Range anchors in the same document and receiver footprint only; no shape or multi-cell anchors. Address/SubAddress map to the native target/external flag, ScreenTip and TextToDisplay use native commands. Internal Follow uses existing link.open selection behavior; NewWindow or explicit request/history options and external Follow refuse before navigation. Delete and collection Delete preserve native cell content/style. Protected sheets refuse edits.

Only Title, Subject, Author, Keywords, Comments (native description), Company; case-insensitive names and actual Excel property indexes 1,2,3,4,5,21. Count/enumeration cover six native fields. Other indexes fail. Office.DocumentProperties/DocumentProperty expose Name, Value, Type=4 and LinkToContent=False via actual file.properties commands; Office child contracts use the same pinned archive outside the unchanged Excel inventory.

exclusions.reason: Native maps have no persistent annotation IDs. Handles are document/sheet/cell-qualified, follow VBA structural edits, and explicit OM19 Delete invalidates parked handles. Copy/cut payloads use native semantics; a parked handle does not follow a native cut to another cell. External topology epochs invalidate feature ranges. Delete/recreate performed wholly outside these VBA members may rebind a cell handle; no independent Excel COM lifetime is claimed.

No remote Author/provider/person services, locally created timestamps, note Shape/rich-text graph, shape hyperlink anchors, custom workbook/worksheet property store, sound notes, browser favorites, linked document creator or Excel thread-pool configuration object. Missing underlying capabilities remain out of scope; Low remains deferred.
Existing native undo, copy/cut and XLSX codecs own annotation payload persistence. Local thread authors are labels, not durable provider identities. No codec or collaboration protocol is added.
Existing UI OpenUrl requests are not an acknowledged VBA continuation. External Follow fails 1004; internal native navigation is implemented. No external action is queued on failure.
